title: MCP termal_acknowledge_mailbox returns 404 'mailbox not found' where the CLI acknowledge of the same mailbox succeeds
outcome: Acknowledging a mailbox the caller can read gives the same result through the MCP tool and the CLI: both succeed for the same mailbox id and receipt, or both refuse with the same reason.
acceptance: MCP termal_acknowledge_mailbox returns 404 'mailbox not found' where the CLI acknowledge of the same mailbox succeeds is done
